contacts.title: Connect the workshops you serve.
contacts.description: Workshop contacts use WhatsApp. They never need a PartsRelay login or a Google account.

directory.title: Contact directory
directory.description: Manage the workshops connected to your company.
directory.privacy: Phone details stay hidden until you open them.

form.add-description: Add the workshop's WhatsApp number. The contact will be active and able to send searches immediately.
form.edit-description: Choose the name your team sees. Leave it blank to use the WhatsApp profile name.
form.phone-hint: Include the international country code, for example +39 or +1.
form.name: Contact name (optional)
form.name-hint: Use the workshop or contact name your team recognizes.
form.phone-error: Enter a valid international phone number including the country code.
form.server-validation: The contact could not be saved. Check the WhatsApp number and contact name, then try again.

empty.title: Your workshop network starts here.
empty.description: Add a workshop's WhatsApp number to connect it with your company.
empty.filtered-description: Choose another status or view all workshop contacts.

error.title: We couldn't load your contacts.
error.description: Check your connection and try again. Your contacts have not been changed.

safety.title: Safe contact management
safety.description: Blocking stops new searches. Deleting a contact is permanent. Review the named confirmation before continuing.
safety.viewer: You can view contacts and search activity. Ask an owner or admin to add, edit, block, or delete a contact.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.description: {{name}} will no longer be able to send new searches to your company through WhatsApp. You can unblock this contact later.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: This permanently deletes {{name}} from your company's contacts. This action cannot be undone.
